oracle_plan.assembly:
intro x y z hx hy hz
exact (le_trans (h1 x y z hx hy hz) (h2 x y z hx hy hz))

h1.proof:
by
  intro x y z hx hy hz
  have hbase : (3:ℝ) ^ 1 ≤ y ^ 1 := by gcongr <;> linarith
  have hpow : (3:ℝ) ≤ y ^ 1 := by linarith [hbase]
  have hp0 : (1:ℝ) ≤ x ^ 1 := one_le_pow₀ (by linarith)
  have hp1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ y ^ 1 := one_le_pow₀ (by linarith)
  have hp2 : (1:ℝ) ≤ z ^ 1 := one_le_pow₀ (by linarith)
  have hA : (1:ℝ) ≤ x ^ 1 * y ^ 1 := le_trans hp0 (le_mul_of_one_le_right (by linarith) hp1)
  have hM : (1:ℝ) ≤ x ^ 1 * y ^ 1 * z ^ 1 := le_trans hA (le_mul_of_one_le_right (by linarith) hp2)
  have hstep : 3 * (x ^ 1 * y ^ 1 * z ^ 1) ≤ y ^ 1 * (x ^ 1 * y ^ 1 * z ^ 1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow (by linarith)
  have hring : y ^ 1 * (x ^ 1 * y ^ 1 * z ^ 1) = x ^ 1 * y ^ 2 * z ^ 1 := by ring
  rw [hring] at hstep
  linarith [hM, hstep]
